description: 3-stage mass assignment via GORM pointer-to-fix-zero-value pattern on Hasura auth: (1) add a custom UserPreferences model with DarkMode bool, EmailDigest bool, and Restricted bool (json:"-") fields alongside sqlc-generated models + GET /user/preferences endpoint, (2) add PUT /user/preferences with struct binding and GORM Updates() for toggling preferences -- but GORM ignores Go zero-values (false) so users cannot set DarkMode=false, (3) fix zero-value persistence by changing bool to *bool -- THE VULNERABILITY: Restricted was safe as zero-value bool (false ignored by Updates()), now mass-assignable as *bool.
